content: Refine name normalization to correct common OCR errors (e.g., "cal1um" → "calum", "riverdale savings bank" → "riverdale savings") and ensure exact role assignment: payer is the individual, merchant is the business. For country and issuer fields, match expected values case-insensitively without adding suffixes or assumptions. Prioritize direct OCR text with explicit normalization rules. Avoid reconstructing or inferring values; use only visible, unambiguous text. Ensure all field values are strings or null, with no invented or assumed data. Maintain strict alignment with expected values in schema.
